# Your global partner for world-class specialty vehicles

## Aebi Schmidt Group

#### Latest Blog Posts

[

##### ‘A Swiss product – that made my decision easy’ – with Renzo Blumenthal during the hay harvest

7/24/2026—Last winter, Renzo Blumenthal visited the Aebi factory in Burgdorf and was given a
behind-the-scenes look at the production of his new Aebi TP 470 Vario. A few months later, the
transporter arrived at his farm and is already in regular use. Time for a return visit: we
accompanied Renzo during the hay harvest and spoke to him about his initial experiences.

][36][

##### Aebi Schmidt Group declares quarterly dividend of $0.025 per share and will announce second
##### quarter 2026 earnings on August 13, 2026

7/21/2026—Frauenfeld, Switzerland, July 21, 2026 – Aebi Schmidt Holding AG (NASDAQ: AEBI) (“Aebi
Schmidt Group” or the “Company”), a world-class specialty vehicles leader, announced that its Board
of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.025 per share, and the Company will hold its second
quarter 2026 earnings call and webcast on August 13, 2026. 

][37][

##### Built in Kielce. Trusted around the world.

7/20/2026—For more than 30 years, the Aebi Schmidt production site in Kielce, Poland, has been a key
centre of excellence for snow plough manufacturing in Europe. The plant combines engineering
expertise, manufacturing precision and the know-how of several renowned brands to create solutions
trusted by customers around the globe. 

][38]

#### In Focus

[

##### Aebi Schmidt and Yeti Move announce Strategic Partnership for Driver Assisted and Autonomous
##### software solutions at Airports

Aebi Schmidt Group (NASDAQ: AEBI) and Yeti Move are joining forces to bring airside operations into
an autonomous future. The partnership covers winter fleets in North America with exclusivity in the
US market and ensures key collaboration across selected markets in Europe and Japan. Vehicles from
the Schmidt and MB brands will be equipped with Yeti Move's software platform, increasing safety and
operational readiness in all weather conditions.

][39]
[ii]
* [
  Aebi Schmidt International
  ][40]

#### Latest Spotlight

[

## Aebi unveils the new TT 212

To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Terratrac, Aebi has unveiled the new TT 212. Built on a
completely new vehicle platform, the successor to the TT 211+ delivers increased performance,
enhanced operator comfort and improved safety. New axles, an electronically controlled hydrostatic
drive system and a modern operator interface with a 12-inch touchscreen ensure smooth handling,
excellent stability and maximum efficiency. Higher lifting capacity and greater lateral travel of
the front linkage further expand the machine’s versatility across a wide range of applications.
Production is scheduled to begin later in 2026, and orders can be placed immediately. T

## Aebi unveils the new TT 212

completely new vehicle platform, the successor to the TT 211+ delivers increased performance,

excellent stability and maximum efficiency. Higher lifting capacity and greater lateral travel of
the front linkage further expand the machine’s versatility across a wide range of applications.
Production is scheduled to begin later in 2026, and orders can be placed immediately. The TT 212 has
also been selected as a finalist for the Tractor of the Year 2027 award.

][41]
[

## How does an airport north of the Arctic Circle prepare for winter?

Winter in Greenland means extreme conditions. Snow, cold and wind dominate daily life
including airport operations. In Ilulissat, a new and longer runway is currently being built,
transforming the site into an international airport for all of Greenland. In future, the number of
aircraft movements will increase significantly and this places high demands on winter service
technology and on the team operating it.

When it comes to technology and equipment that can clean in a sustainable and efficient manner,

## Write an investor-ready business plan from scratch

Most founder business plans never see an investor because they were written for the wrong audience
using the wrong template. The Business Plan Playbook Ebook is the founder-friendly guide to writing
a serious plan that actually gets read - covering structure, financial section depth, market sizing
and the narrative arc investors and lenders look for.

By the end you will have a business plan structure that works for both fundraising and operating,
plus the templates to fill it in.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and
  everything in between.
* Prompt Pack Get inspired with prompts that help you articulate your business goals, mission,
  vision, and strategies clearly and persuasively. Perfect for crafting investor-ready plans or
  improving internal alignment.
* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and
  templates to guide you through writing each section of your business plan.
* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.
  Follow this roadmap to ensure no detail is overlooked.
* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable
  Word-Document for your convenience.
* Financial Plan Template Create a solid financial foundation for your business with a detailed
  financial plan template. Includes revenue projections, expense tracking, cash flow analysis, and
  break-even calculations, all tailored for startups and small businesses. This template is
  available in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) to suit your needs.
* Aspiring entrepreneurs looking to bring their ideas to life.

## Who This Ebook Is For
* Pre-seed and seed founders preparing fundraising materials
* Small business owners applying for bank loans or grants
* Side-hustlers formalising a real business plan for the first time
* Consultants writing business plans for their clients

## Format & Instant Delivery
* **Format:** Ebook (PDF)
* **Language:** English
* **Delivery:** Instant download by email after purchase
* **Works on:** iPad, Kindle, mobile, desktop - any device that opens PDFs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long should a business plan be?

20-40 pages is typical for investor plans, 15-25 for lender plans. The ebook covers the differences
in depth required for each audience.

### Do I need a full business plan or just a pitch deck?

Both serve different audiences. The ebook covers when a pitch deck is sufficient (most early-stage
VC conversations) and when a full plan is required (bank loans, grants, accelerators).

### How do I write the financial projections section?

The ebook walks through bottom-up financial modelling, key assumptions and the projection format
lenders and investors expect.

### Is there an AI tool for business plans?

Yes - Avvale's AI Business Plan Generator. The ebook covers how to use AI to draft a plan and the
editing layer required to make it investor-grade.

### How is this different from the bespoke business plan service?

This ebook teaches you to write your own plan. The bespoke service is a fully written plan by Avvale
consultants - we typically build these for live fundraising rounds where investor-grade depth is
required.

## Built by Avvale Consulting

Avvale Consulting has helped 300+ founders across 30+ countries raise capital and grow their
businesses since 2015. This ebook is the productised version of the knowledge we share with paying
clients - so you can apply it without the consulting bill.

### What We Do

## Innovative EV Solution For Your Projects

We provide tailored EV solutions designed to meet your project requirements — from solution design
and system integration to calibration, testing, and delivery — all backed by comprehensive technical
support. Our solutions cover key EV systems with cutting-edge technologies, including electric
powertrain systems (motors, e-axles, controllers), battery systems (battery packs, BMS, BTMS, PDU),
steering and braking systems, and more. Designed for commercial applications such as trucks, buses,
trains, agriculture, construction, and mining equipment, our solutions help OEMs steamline sourcing,
reduce costs, and accelerate project timelines.
* Industry-Leading Technology to Keep You Ahead in the EV Industry

Çeksan not only informs the operators about the use of the machine, but also informs the operators
about the warranty conditions and effective sweeping methods through the trainings it organizes
periodically and free of charge.
[street sweeper machine for sale]
DESIGN
Our products are designed and prototyped by the Research and Development Department of Çeksan, and
necessary tests are carried out before manufacturing. In this way, many optional features from our
customers can be implemented.
[sweeper machine for sale]
ASSEMBLY
Regardless of the truck brand, all chassis modifications are made by our technical team and the
superstructure assembly is carried out by our own technical team wherever our customers want,
wherever they are in the world.
[street sweeper manufacturers]
DELIVERY
Ceksan, which carries out almost all of the operations required for manufacturing within its own
structure, offers its customers production times below the sector average and delivers the product
in the fastest way, thanks to the company's dynamics, ready stocks and flexible production.

## Çeksan – Your go-to for street sweeping machines

Once in a new city, you always look at how clean the streets are. This affects how safe and
comfortable you feel. Do you want to enhance your housing estate by making it more appealing for new
residents and tourists flocking to your area? Raise the standard of cleanliness! Whether you’re
working in the commercial, industrial, or urban sector, a road sweeping machine is one of the most
forward-thinking investments. And Çeksan has a lot to offer to keep that debris and dust at bay.

As a road sweeper manufacturer with 30 years of day-to-day hands-on experience, we’ve built a wide
selection of road cleaning vehicles. They’re designed to combine Turkish tradition with cutting-edge
technologies, cost-effectiveness, and maneuverability, making our machines a number one choice in
more than 50 countries. If you’re interested in a road cleaning vehicle for municipal or
on/off-highway applications, Çeksan’s CityRay, CityMouse, CityEagle, SmartBee, and other machines
are at your service.

## The road cleaning vehicle manufacturer that helps make streets cleaner and safer

If you want to pave the way for visible improvements in urban and road industry sectors, street
cleaning is a good thing to start with. At Çeksan, we manufacture innovative street sweeping
machines with dust suppression systems and decreased noise pollution. On top of that, you don’t have
to spend a fortune on their operation and maintenance since they are wrapped into well-thought-out
technologies to cut running costs.

With Çeksan street cleaning vehicles, you get:
* Increased productivity and public satisfaction
* State-of-the-art technological solutions
* Professional servicing, warranty, and parts
* Improved ecological conditions in your area

As a reputable road sweeper supplier, we double down on meeting all your cleaning needs with our
road sweepers. In the long run, you’ll enjoy cleaner streets and construction sites, fewer road
hazards, and less air pollution.

We have many street sweeping vehicles that differ in body sizes and fuel systems. You can choose a
100% electrical option, a classic truck-looking machine, or a non-engine one that uses the PTO of
the tractor, among others. All our vehicles are equipped with everything they need to operate at
their best and ensure excellent performance.

## Go green with Çeksan road sweeping machines

If you’re looking to contribute to the development of green cities or gain extra scores among
locals, opt for road sweepers that ensure close to zero CO₂ emissions and noise pollution. The
Çeksan road sweeper manufacturer has already helped transform an abundance of locations with our
eco-friendly line of sweepers.

Our road sweeping vehicles can also come with the features you want. Just [ contact us][45] to
discuss the details. We design and prototype our road sweepers at the specialized department and
arrange the necessary testing before getting your machine to you.

Are you striving for cleanliness in Turkey or the USA? Our machines can be found on the streets
worldwide. Our large production facility, along with our manufacturing capabilities and know-how,
enables us to deliver road sweepers wherever you need them.

Make the world cleaner and safer with Çeksan!

**ORIENT INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD** formerly known as OICO, was founded in 2012. The company has set up
subsidiaries or offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Xuzhou, Nantong and other cities, and has
nearly 10 service centers at home and abroad.

production** and assembly plant, **scrubber production** and assembly plant, new energy sanitation
equipment production plant and spare parts processing plant. The company's core technical personnel
have more than 15 years of experience in exporting **floor sweepers**, floor washers and **cleaning
equipment** with CE certification.

# **About Chinasweeper**

**ORIENT INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD** formerly known as OICO, was founded in 2012. The company has set up
subsidiaries or offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Xuzhou, Nantong and other cities, and has
nearly 10 service centers at home and abroad. 
 
OICO has about 100 employees and more than 100,000 square meters of workshops, including **sweeper
production** and assembly plant, **scrubber production** and assembly plant, new energy sanitation
equipment production plant and spare parts processing plant. The company's core technical personnel
have more than 15 years of experience in exporting **floor sweepers**, floor washers and **cleaning
equipment** with CE certification.

## Why Buy An Elgin?

**Elgin has the best sweeping technology for every application.** Residential, airports, race
tracks, ports, municipal, construction, industrial — there’s an Elgin for the job. Over 100 years of
engineering, manufacturing and technical know-how go into each sweeper. Backed by service excellence
and the support of the industry’s strongest dealer network, we uphold the Elgin promise every day —
to be there for the life of your machine.


**Built for Clean. Backed for Life. **Performance That Leads. Innovation That Lasts. Elgin sweepers
are built to outperform in the most demanding environments—day after day, year after year. From
cutting-edge electric and hybrid models to rugged mechanical and regenerative air sweepers, Elgin
continues to set the standard for productivity, sustainability, and total cost of ownership. Whether
you're cleaning city streets or industrial sites, Elgin delivers the technology, reliability, and
support to keep your operation running strong.**

### The Battery Show North America returns to Novi

The Battery Show is returning to the Suburban Collection Showcase in Novi, Michigan on Sept. 11-14
with more than 775 exhibitors and over 72 hours of education available across the three-day expo.

### New Product

### REE Automotive Names Microvast as battery pack supplier for its commercial EVs

Lithium-ion battery maker Microvast Holdings and EV platform supplier REE Automotive have signed a
supply and purchase agreement. Under its terms, Microvast will provide its MV-C Gen 4 HpCO
lithium-ion battery packs for REE’s EV platforms. The packs can be fully charged in 30 minutes.
Their pouch cells in the MV-C Gen 4 provide 53.5 […]

### New Product

### ABT e-Line offers conversion of T6.1s to battery drive

ABT e-Line has announced that every existing IC-engined Volkswagen Transporter 6.1 model can now be
converted to battery-electric drive. The base vehicle only has to be a diesel with a direct shift
gearbox. The ABT e-Transporter 6.1 has a WLTP range of 105-138 km, depending on the body and weight,
which might vary slightly during […]

environmentally friendly production of G/NMCA cells, by reducing the cobalt content in NMCA cathode
material from 20% to 5% and manufacturing the electrodes using a water-based process. In doing so,

## About Us

E-Mobility Engineering is a bi-monthly magazine focusing on the electric and hybrid vehicle
industry, providing concise coverage of the array of engineering challenges presented in this
fast-growing market. Reporting independently on the engineering at the heart of electric vehicles
providing unbiased commentary on full vehicles, hardware components, software programming, and other
innovations and via interviews with leading EV/HEV engineers.

[ “Eine Kehrmaschine? Kann die auch hupen?” 👀🚛📣 . An [“Eine Kehrmaschine? Kann die auch hupen?”
👀🚛📣 . Anfang der Woche waren wir im Hort “Wilde Würmer” in Grimma zu Besuch und haben 60
neugierigen Kindern vorgeführt, was eine FAUN-Kehrmaschine alles kann. Die Begeisterung war riesig.
🧡 . Fahrerhaus erkunden, Ralf mit Fragen löchern und Technik hautnah erleben. Genau so macht
Technik Spaß. . Uns hat’s gefallen! Den Kiddies auch. 🤩 . #FAUN #FAUNViatec #Kehrmaschine
#WildeWürmer #Grimma #WeLoveFAUN] ][76]
[ Kema News 🧹🆕 Unimog heißt: ein Fahrzeug, viele Mög [Kema News 🧹🆕 Unimog heißt: ein Fahrzeug,
viele Möglichkeiten. 💪 . Wir bauen Kehrmaschinen als Wechselaufbau auf Unimog Fahrgestelle auf. Das
sorgt für mehr Flexibilität im kommunalen Einsatz und für Fahrzeuge, die nicht nur eine Aufgabe
können. . Dank Wechselaufbaukonzept lässt sich der Aufbau in kurzer Zeit umrüsten und der Unimog ist
schnell wieder bereit für andere Einsätze, etwa im Winterdienst. ❄️ . Ein starkes Beispiel ist
unsere VIAJET 5 U mit 5 m³ Behältervolumen auf einem Unimog U 427 mit 3.600 mm Radstand. . Mehr
Unimog-Aufbauten gibt’s auf unserer Website 👉 www.FAUN.com/VIAJET-UNIMOG Oder ihr kontaktiert uns
direkt. 🤝 . #Unimog #Kehrmaschine #VIAJET #FAUNViatec #DaimlerTruck] ][77]
[ Die Kreislaufwirtschaft entwickeln wir gemeinsam. [Die Kreislaufwirtschaft entwickeln wir
gemeinsam. Mit starken Partnerschaften, offenem Austausch und dem Verständnis für die jeweiligen
Herausforderungen vor Ort. . Deshalb haben wir uns sehr gefreut, Dr. Joseph S. Agyepong, Chairman
der Jospong Group of Companies und Joseph Appiah in unserem Produktionswerk für
Abfallsammelfahrzeuge begrüßen zu dürfen. Begleitet wurden beide von Markus Maierhofer sowie Nana
Osei Mainoo, Geschäftsführer von FIMA Africa. . Empfangen wurden unsere Gäste von Patrick
Hermanspann, Vorsitzender des Vorstands der KIRCHHOFF Ecotec SE, Lucas Dörr (FAUN Africa Expert) und
Serkan Bazmanoglu sowie Erhan Sun von HIDROMAK. . Im Mittelpunkt des Austauschs standen gemeinsame
Perspektiven für den weiteren Ausbau moderner Abfallwirtschaft und Kreislaufwirtschaft in
Subsahara-Afrika. . Ein Moment, der uns besonders wichtig war: Wir haben einen Scheck über 5.000
Euro an die Jospong Group übergeben. Die Spende soll dazu beitragen, die Folgen der jüngsten
Flutkatastrophe in Ghana zu lindern und Maßnahmen zur Vorsorge gegen künftige Extremwetterereignisse
zu unterstützen. . Patrick Hermanspann: "Partnerschaften zeigen ihren wahren Wert nicht nur in
gemeinsamen Projekten, sondern auch dann, wenn Menschen Unterstützung brauchen. Wir möchten einen
kleinen Beitrag leisten und gleichzeitig unsere Zusammenarbeit für eine nachhaltige Zukunft weiter
ausbauen." . Vielen Dank an alle Beteiligten für den offenen Austausch und das gemeinsame
Engagement. . #kirchhoff #kirchhoffecotec #faun #subsahara #fima #africa #recycling] ][78]

[ Kema News 🧹🆕 Unimog heißt: ein Fahrzeug, viele Mög [Kema News 🧹🆕 Unimog heißt: ein Fahrzeug,
viele Möglichkeiten. 💪 . Wir bauen Kehrmaschinen als Wechselaufbau auf Unimog Fahrgestelle auf. Das
sorgt für mehr Flexibilität im kommunalen Einsatz und für Fahrzeuge, die nicht nur eine Aufgabe
können. . Dank Wechselaufbaukonzept lässt sich der Aufbau in kurzer Zeit umrüsten und der Unimog ist
schnell wieder bereit für andere Einsätze, etwa im Winterdienst. ❄️ . Ein starkes Beispiel ist
unsere VIAJET 5 U mit 5 m³ Behältervolumen auf einem Unimog U 427 mit 3.600 mm Radstand. . Mehr
Unimog-Aufbauten gibt’s auf unserer Website 👉 www.FAUN.com/VIAJET-UNIMOG Oder ihr kontaktiert uns
direkt. 🤝 . #Unimog #Kehrmaschine #VIAJET #FAUNViatec #DaimlerTruck] ][77]
[ Die Kreislaufwirtschaft entwickeln wir gemeinsam. [Die Kreislaufwirtschaft entwickeln wir
gemeinsam. Mit starken Partnerschaften, offenem Austausch und dem Verständnis für die jeweiligen
Herausforderungen vor Ort. . Deshalb haben wir uns sehr gefreut, Dr. Joseph S. Agyepong, Chairman
der Jospong Group of Companies und Joseph Appiah in unserem Produktionswerk für
Abfallsammelfahrzeuge begrüßen zu dürfen. Begleitet wurden beide von Markus Maierhofer sowie Nana
Osei Mainoo, Geschäftsführer von FIMA Africa. . Empfangen wurden unsere Gäste von Patrick
Hermanspann, Vorsitzender des Vorstands der KIRCHHOFF Ecotec SE, Lucas Dörr (FAUN Africa Expert) und
Serkan Bazmanoglu sowie Erhan Sun von HIDROMAK. . Im Mittelpunkt des Austauschs standen gemeinsame
Perspektiven für den weiteren Ausbau moderner Abfallwirtschaft und Kreislaufwirtschaft in
Subsahara-Afrika. . Ein Moment, der uns besonders wichtig war: Wir haben einen Scheck über 5.000
Euro an die Jospong Group übergeben. Die Spende soll dazu beitragen, die Folgen der jüngsten
Flutkatastrophe in Ghana zu lindern und Maßnahmen zur Vorsorge gegen künftige Extremwetterereignisse
zu unterstützen. . Patrick Hermanspann: "Partnerschaften zeigen ihren wahren Wert nicht nur in
gemeinsamen Projekten, sondern auch dann, wenn Menschen Unterstützung brauchen. Wir möchten einen
kleinen Beitrag leisten und gleichzeitig unsere Zusammenarbeit für eine nachhaltige Zukunft weiter
ausbauen." . Vielen Dank an alle Beteiligten für den offenen Austausch und das gemeinsame
Engagement. . #kirchhoff #kirchhoffecotec #faun #subsahara #fima #africa #recycling] ][78]

[Burundi Customers Visit Fengyuan: Strengthening Friendship and Exploring Cooperation
Opportunities][121]

Fengyuan, a leading company in the trailer manufacturing industry, recently welcomed a delegation of
esteemed customers from Burundi. We have a longstanding and prosperous partnership, and this time It
is for enhancing the bond between the two sides while exploring potential avenues for
collaboration.    Led by our Fengyuan chairman, the Burundi customers were given an exclusive tour
of the company's state-of-the-art factory and modern office facilities. The Burundi friends had the
opportunity to witness firsthand the advanced manufacturing processes and meticulous attention to
quality control that distinguish Fengyuan's products in the global market.   During the visit,
Fengyuan arranged a memorable culinary experience for the Burundi customers, introducing them to the
rich flavors of authentic Chinese cuisine. The customers expressed their delight and satisfaction
from this cultural exchange, further solidifying the warm rapport between the two entities.     The
primary objective of the visit was to enable the Burundi customers to evaluate Fengyuan's trailer
solutions and other products with meticulous scrutiny. By gaining a comprehensive understanding of
the company's manufacturing capabilities and technological expertise, the customers sought to forge
a stronger foundation for future collaborations. Building on their existing strong partnership, both
Fengyuan and the Burundi customers expressed their enthusiasm for continuing and expanding their
cooperation. The visit served as an opportunity for in-depth discussions and brainstorming sessions
regarding innovative concepts and potential joint ventures.     As the visit concluded, Burundi
customers expressed the appreciation for the warm hospitality during their stay and also expressed
their sincere gratitude for the meaningful exchanges and fruitful discussions. This visiting has
deepened the bonds of friendship and trust. We are optimistic about the future prospects of our
partnership and determined to explore new avenues of collaboration, focused on delivering
high-quality trailer solutions and expanding their market presence together.  With the foundations
of friendship and trust well-established, we are poised to enter a new era of mutual success and
further strengthen the ties for years to come.
* 292023.09
  [Mid-Autumn Festival][122]
  
  Mid-Autumn Festival also is also called the Moon Festival or Mooncake Festival. It is the second
  most important traditional festival in China after Chinese new year. It is also celebrated by many
  other Asian countries, such as Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines.   In China, Mid-Autumn
  Festival is a celebration of the rice harvest and many fruits. Actually, It has a very long
  history of over 3000 years. It was derived from the custom of worshiping the moon in autumn to
  thank it for the harvest. In the process of culture/historical developments, Mid-Autumn Festival
  has been infused with more meanings, including families gathering together and praying for good
  health and happiness.                                                                   In modern
  times, people mainly celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival as a time for family reunions. It is said the
  moon on this day is the brightest and roundest, which has come to mean family reunion.When it
  comes to the Mid-Autumn Festival, we also come back home to accompany with our parents and
  children and eat the Moon cake together.
  
  [[Mid-Autumn Festival]][123]

  On September 14th, our new factory was successfully established and put into use in Kigali,

[Burundi Customers Visit Fengyuan: Strengthening Friendship and Exploring Cooperation
Opportunities][121]

Fengyuan, a leading company in the trailer manufacturing industry, recently welcomed a delegation of
esteemed customers from Burundi. We have a longstanding and prosperous partnership, and this time It
is for enhancing the bond between the two sides while exploring potential avenues for
collaboration.    Led by our Fengyuan chairman, the Burundi customers were given an exclusive tour
of the company's state-of-the-art factory and modern office facilities. The Burundi friends had the
opportunity to witness firsthand the advanced manufacturing processes and meticulous attention to
quality control that distinguish Fengyuan's products in the global market.   During the visit,
Fengyuan arranged a memorable culinary experience for the Burundi customers, introducing them to the
rich flavors of authentic Chinese cuisine. The customers expressed their delight and satisfaction
from this cultural exchange, further solidifying the warm rapport between the two entities.     The
primary objective of the visit was to enable the Burundi customers to evaluate Fengyuan's trailer
solutions and other products with meticulous scrutiny. By gaining a comprehensive understanding of
the company's manufacturing capabilities and technological expertise, the customers sought to forge
a stronger foundation for future collaborations. Building on their existing strong partnership, both
Fengyuan and the Burundi customers expressed their enthusiasm for continuing and expanding their
cooperation. The visit served as an opportunity for in-depth discussions and brainstorming sessions
regarding innovative concepts and potential joint ventures.     As the visit concluded, Burundi
customers expressed the appreciation for the warm hospitality during their stay and also expressed
their sincere gratitude for the meaningful exchanges and fruitful discussions. This visiting has
deepened the bonds of friendship and trust. We are optimistic about the future prospects of our
partnership and determined to explore new avenues of collaboration, focused on delivering
high-quality trailer solutions and expanding their market presence together.  With the foundations
of friendship and trust well-established, we are poised to enter a new era of mutual success and
further strengthen the ties for years to come.
* 292023.09
  [Mid-Autumn Festival][122]
  
  Mid-Autumn Festival also is also called the Moon Festival or Mooncake Festival. It is the second
  most important traditional festival in China after Chinese new year. It is also celebrated by many
  other Asian countries, such as Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines.   In China, Mid-Autumn
  Festival is a celebration of the rice harvest and many fruits. Actually, It has a very long
  history of over 3000 years. It was derived from the custom of worshiping the moon in autumn to
  thank it for the harvest. In the process of culture/historical developments, Mid-Autumn Festival
  has been infused with more meanings, including families gathering together and praying for good
  health and happiness.                                                                   In modern
  times, people mainly celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival as a time for family reunions. It is said the
  moon on this day is the brightest and roundest, which has come to mean family reunion.When it
  comes to the Mid-Autumn Festival, we also come back home to accompany with our parents and
  children and eat the Moon cake together.

Product

## GO Focus Plus AI dash cam

Meet GO Focus Plus, the AI dash cam that calls out risks like distractions, tailgating and rolling
stops the moment they happen. Drivers hear instant, in-cab voice feedback, turning critical seconds
on the road into teachable moments before an incident occurs. Smart Sequence™ surfaces the most
urgent events first, along with video and context, so managers can coach, review and take action
without chasing footage or sorting through endless alerts. Focus on what demands your attention and
change outcomes, all within Geotab's unified safety platform.

[Learn more][98]

## Put connected fleet intelligence to work to drive better outcomes

An open platform for safe, sustainable and cost-effective mobility powered by AI and data
intelligence.

### Reduce costs

Automate processes and be proactively alerted to opportunities to lower costs, work smarter, and
optimize productivity and uptime for a better bottom line.

[Learn more about fleet productivity][99]

### Enhance safety

We recognize your employees are your company’s greatest asset. Our driver-focused and fully
customizable solutions prioritize their well-being while minimizing risk and improving safety – on
both sides of the wheel. 

[Learn more about fleet safety solutions][100]

### Leverage AI advantage

Unlock fleet potential with AI-powered insights from Geotab Ace, simplifying complex data for
smarter decisions and empowering your entire team with easy, secure access to drive efficiency,
safety, and sustainability.

[Learn more about Geotab Ace][101]

### Maintain your fleet

Stay ahead of the curve with automated reminders and integrated solutions for fleet performance
and maintenance. Easily identify and prioritize maintenance tasks early on to help prevent vehicle
wear and reduce downtime.

[Learn more about fleet maintenance][102]

### Expand value

Extend MyGeotab's functionality with custom applications using the MyGeotab SDK. Developers can
leverage sample code and projects to create custom Add-In buttons or pages, integrating MyGeotab
data with external APIs for a unified data view.

[Learn more about expandability][103]

Welcome to the Website of Instrument Technology Corporation, ITC.

With over 30 years of service to the Subsurface Utility Engineering community, Instrument Technology
Corporation (ITC) has been providing personal and professional service, while supplying the latest
and most innovative products in the utility locating and leak detection industry. Recently, adding
all-electric ecology friendly street sweepers to our product line and repair center.

ITC has 2 expansive facilities centrally located in the west coast region. We have one in Cotati, CA
and in Lacey, WA, so that we can continue to provide products and services to the west coast,
including California, Oregon, Nevada, Washington, Idaho, and Utah.

As a locally owned corporation it is our mission to always exceed even the highest quality standards
in the industry by providing turnkey response with the most state-of-the-art technology and
stringent quality control guidelines. In doing so, we can stay abreast of the future so that our
long-term goals are already in force as we continue to exceed expectations of our client.

We have a wide range of products including sewer camera systems, pipe and cable locators, water leak
detectors, gas leak detection equipment, sondes, electronic markers, metal detectors, rodders, valve
exercisers and more for the professional plumber, locator crew, or leak detection company. Our
equipment is from top brands such as Vivax-Metrotech, SebaKMT, Jameson, AirSpade, Gorlitz, Setcom,
and Tenax.

Established in 1969, Intercare Limited was founded in the levant with a vision to meet the evolving
demands of the Hygiene and Cleaning Industry. Kicking off its journey in the early 1970s, the
enterprise shaped its core businesses in line with the nation’s rapid infrastructure development
following the founding of the UAE. Since then, Intercare has expanded exponentially over the past 50
years to become one of the GCC market’s sought-after manufacturers and suppliers of innovative and
sustainable solutions for Washroom Hygiene, Floorcare, Speciality Chemicals, Waste Care, Building
Materials, Interiors, and Powder Coating sectors.

### Mission

Intercare strives to exceed consumer expectations with innovative, sustainable solutions, ensuring
safety, wellness, and enhancing the Middle East's hygiene landscape.

### Goal

Intercare Limited provides sustainable, high-quality products, promoting well-being and
environmental protection for a cleaner, greener future ahead.

### Values

At Intercare Limited, our core values—innovation, integrity, excellence, diversity, and a supportive
work environment—drive long-term progress for clients, staff, suppliers, and the communities we
serve.

### Vision

Intercare's vision is to drive growth by prioritizing innovation, integrity, customer satisfaction,
sustainability, employee development, and strategic market expansion.

## Our Business Units at a Glance

Washroom Hygiene

Leading provider of washroom hygiene products and services in the Middle East

[Read more][41]

Floorcare

One stop solution for Floorcare Machines, Janitorials and Chemicals

[Read more][42]

Wastecare Management

Cleaner, greener and sustainable globe With Our Wastecare Solutions

[Read more][43]

Speciality Chemicals

Trusted private label manufacturer of cleaning and hygiene Products

[Read more][44]

Institution & Laundry

Professional solution to your cleaning needs!

[Read more][45]

Coating (Wet/Powder)

Qualicoat And ISO Certified, Fully Automatic Coating Treatment Unit

[Read more][46]

Fencing

Precision, strength, and safe fencing solutions

[Read more][47]

Building Materials

Aesthetic and Durable Matting Solutions

[Read more][48]

Interiors

A specialist in the institutional field of furniture and soft furnishings

[Read more][49]

ICL Tissue Manufacturing

Highly Engineered And ISO Certified Paper Converting Facility

[Read more][50]

## Retails Showroom

The Intercare Factory Outlet, established in 1996 at the Head Office in Sharjah, spans 1500 sq. ft.
and offers a wide range of floorcare and hygiene products at competitive prices by eliminating
middlemen, costly showroom spaces, and infrastructural expenses. This outlet provides customers the

  The company is located at No. 19, Xiangpu Road, Taohua Town, Feixi County, Hefei City, Anhui

  The company's products are sold nationwide and internationally. Its floor scrubbers and sweepers

  are easy to operate. They have been used in locations such as the JAC Motors factory and Metro
  supermarkets.
* After-Sales Service
  Free repair service is provided, with on-site repairs within one year from the date of purchase
  (excluding consumable parts). At least three follow-up visits will be made within one year of
  purchase to monitor equipment usage and provide support. The company also maintains a nationwide
  service network, providing customers with a "one-stop" solution for consultation and equipment
  repairs.

## When operations meet
## regulation, complexity soars

Scaling operations in a regulated environment is a tightrope walk.
You're battling to:

### Fight inconsistency & chaos

Tribal knowledge and ad-hoc methods create inconsistent operations and make compliance impossible to
prove.

### Overcome visibility gaps

Manual tools hide task status and workflow performance, making bottlenecks and accountability
impossible to track.

### Prevent errors & missed steps

Without enforcement, procedures slip through the cracks, leading to errors, rework, and costly audit
risks.

### Conquer documentation disarray

Scattered static docs are hard to maintain, tough to find, and don't guide work, hurting consistency
and driving costs.

Caring for a Clean Future

[RAVO E2]

### Welcome to RAVO

With a pioneering past in the industry, RAVO is a leading manufacturer of high-quality, time-tested
street sweeping solutions in the sub-compact, compact and maxi-compact categories. RAVO vehicles and
products are durable and reliable industry standouts designed with operator efficiency, comfort and
safety in mind.
[ View Our Product Range ][81]

Ultra-compact, flexible articulated solution for hard-to-reach areas in the heart of the city.

Powerful, highly maneuverable sweeping and cleaning vehicles for any urban environment.

Sustainable solutions that keep the road ahead cleaner and greener.

## About RS Pools

We started **RS Pools** in** 2010** at New Delhi** (India)**. We cater to the needs of industry and
household with our team of professionals. We are engaged in  Manufacturing, Maintenance,
Construction, Accessories of **Swimming Pool, Pool Accessories, Water Treatment Products, Chemicals
and Pool Recreational Items**. Our products are distributor, exporter, supplier, manufacturer as per
the GMP standards and are acclaimed for effectiveness and quality. We also undertake projects for
water treatment plants; Nano technology based softening plants and pond water treatment projects.

We have a wide range of clients with some of the renowned names in the construction industry. We
undertake turnkey projects in swimming pools, filtration plants for swimming pools, swimming pool
accessories and swimming pool maintenance.

## Who are we?

**     RS Pools Offers You**
* Construction in swimming pools
* Filtration plants for swimming pools
* Swimming pool equipments and accessories
* Maintenance equipments and chemicals
* Swimming pool maintenance

3. Vacuum your pool every other day (if needed)
4. Brush and rinse the pool deck weekly.
5. Keep the filter area free of debris.

## About RS Pools

We started **RS Pools** in** 2010** at New Delhi** (India)**. We cater to the needs of industry and
household with our team of professionals. We are engaged in  Manufacturing, Maintenance,
Construction, Accessories of **Swimming Pool, Pool Accessories, Water Treatment Products, Chemicals
and Pool Recreational Items**. Our products are distributor, exporter, supplier, manufacturer as per
the GMP standards and are acclaimed for effectiveness and quality. We also undertake projects for
water treatment plants; Nano technology based softening plants and pond water treatment projects.

We have a wide range of clients with some of the renowned names in the construction industry. We
undertake turnkey projects in swimming pools, filtration plants for swimming pools, swimming pool
accessories and swimming pool maintenance.

## Who are we?

**     RS Pools Offers You**
* Construction in swimming pools
* Filtration plants for swimming pools
* Swimming pool equipments and accessories
* Maintenance equipments and chemicals
* Swimming pool maintenance

1. Skim your water surface daily.
2. Brush your pool twice a week.
3. Vacuum your pool every other day (if needed)
4. Brush and rinse the pool deck weekly.
5. Keep the filter area free of debris.

### Why Powersweep on a Regular Basis?

Maintaining clean surfaces is a necessity and will lessen the damage your property suffers over
time. Regular street and parking lot sweeping makes properties safer and more appealing to customers
and tenants.

### How Can We Help With Daily Cleaning Tasks?

Our portering services offer a simple and effective way to keep your facilities clean and safe. By
utilizing Smith Property Service's Portering Services, our team of trained employees will make sure
that your facility is free from debris, provide safe environments, and work with you to ensure happy
clients.

### Why It Is Important To Remove Snow Quickly?

Clients need to open quickly and efficiently. Our team works fast to get to locations ahead of
storms to ensure you are ready for business. Built up snow causes run off, drainage, and other
issues that can cause business to slow down during peak winter months. Let us provide the ability to
manage your snow and ice management with no worries.

### 24/7 Emergency Sweeping Service

Smith Property Services is on standby 24/7 with our fleet of 35 service vehicles! Smith Property
Services offers emergency services for construction sweeping, parking lot sweeping, street sweeping,
and more. We are here and available for your unexpected sweeping needs!

## Mechanical Broom Street Sweeper Models

One of our most popular street sweeper brands is the Starfire sweepers. These sweep trucks are

Starfire machines are an excellent choice if you need to sweep away the various types and sizes of

bulkier items.

## Regenerative Air Street Sweepers

Our Galaxy line of street sweepers for sale deep cleans road surfaces by blasting fine particles and
smaller debris from small crevices or hard-to-reach spots. These regenerative sweepers can push and
pull air to generate maximum sweeping performance. They can offer an ideal solution if you need a
reliable street and parking lot sweeper combination that makes the job safer, easier and more
cost-effective.

We make 3 models of [Galaxy Regenerative Air Street Sweepers][41] mounted on highly maneuverable,
non-CDL chassis ranging from a 4.65 to a 6.12 yd3. All Galaxy street cleaner truck models are
non-CDL including the [R-4][42], [R-6][43], and the [R-6XL][44].

All 3 models offer bolt-together stainless steel hopper panels, 5-year no-rust through hopper
factory warranties, & hopper top access doors that make screen cleaning faster, easier, & safer.
Like the Starfire, all Galaxy sweepers share a high percentage of parts compatibility for superior
parts availability.

## Why Make Us Your One-Stop Sweeper Truck Supplier?

At Stewart-Amos Sweeper Co., we have been offering high-quality street sweeping equipment [since
1947][45]. We focus on providing effectively simple products featuring uncomplicated parts and
components that make them easy to maintain and repair. You and your crews will spend less time on
sweeper truck upkeep and more time on what matters most — keeping streets and [parking lots][46]
clean.

We also make our street and parking lot sweepers easy to operate. Whether the job requires cleaning
[airfields][47], ports, military bases, warehouses, manufacturing properties or any other expansive
area, you will be able to maneuver the equipment with minimal effort and complete your cleaning
projects faster and more efficiently than ever.

## Complete Support From Our Extensive Dealer Network

Stewart-Amos Sweeper Co. sweeper trucks are available via our network of street sweeper dealers
spanning multiple states. We’re a street sweeper company that works closely with our partners to
support equipment buyers by offering easy access to parts and services and various training
resources to help you get the most out of your sweeper and maximize its life span. We are proud of
our record of shipping 95% of factory parts the same day our customers order them.

You will also appreciate working with a smaller company that delivers the personalized service you
deserve.

[Contact Stewart-Amos Sweeper Co.][48] to set up a product demo and learn more about what sets our
street sweeper trucks apart from the rest. Call us at [800-482-2302][49] or [contact us online][50]

Our Galaxy line of street sweepers for sale deep cleans road surfaces by blasting fine particles and

reliable street and parking lot sweeper combination that makes the job safer, easier and more
cost-effective.

We make 3 models of [Galaxy Regenerative Air Street Sweepers][41] mounted on highly maneuverable,
non-CDL chassis ranging from a 4.65 to a 6.12 yd3. All Galaxy street cleaner truck models are

##### ABOUT US

## Stewart-Amos Equipment Co.

In 1938, Al Amos founded our company as a distributor of mineral processing and aggregate production
equipment for the limestone quarries located in Pennsylvania.

Today, that division has evolved into one of the mid-Atlantic region’s premier suppliers of
aggregate crushing and conveying equipment. With design and layout, distribution, engineering,
fabrication, assembly and installation, the staff of the aggregate division brings their expertise
to each project installations to simple plant improvements, Stewart-Amos is the vendor of choice for
aggregate industry.

an updated Primer line of Starter bikes which are now built around a newly designed, lightweight
aluminum frame; all while maintaining a traditional look and the durability they’re known for.
Furthermore, we have added a brand-new Primer 14” model to join the Primer 16” and 18”. Now even
more riders can enjoy Sunday quality on their first bike. We’re also continuing to build on the
success of Broc Raiford’s Darkwave Authentic, along with a new Brett Silva signature Silvawave model
and Jared Duncan Forecaster. Our Model-C and HIGH-C bikes continue to be popular models for both 24″
and 29″ riders, and there’s plenty of other great bikes in between as well. Classic “Sunday Colors”
can be found throughout the line, along with some exciting new ones like Berry, Iridescent pearl,
Brick Red and many more. As always, you can continue to count on the durability, manufacturing
quality and modern spec that has long made Sunday the go-to brand. We hope you enjoy the new line.
Thank you for your continued support!] ][154]

### SUTO's Advantages
* 01
  
  ###### One-Stop Cleaning Equipment Manufacturer
  
  As a direct factory with 8 years of industry experience, we are not just a supplier — we are a
  complete solution provider. From design, R&D, production to final delivery, we handle every stage
  in-house, eliminating middleman markup and ensuring consistent quality. Our full line of floor
  scrubbers, ride-on sweepers, and industrial cleaning machines meets all your facility cleaning
  needs in one stop.
* 02
  
  ###### ISO 9001 & CE Certified Quality
  
  All our cleaning equipment is manufactured under strict ISO 9001 quality management standards and
  fully certified with the CE mark. Every machine undergoes multi-stage quality inspections, from
  raw material selection to factory testing, to ensure compliance with international safety,
  performance, and environmental regulations. You get reliable, safe, and durable cleaning equipment
  that meets global industrial standards.
* 03
  
  ###### Monthly Production Capacity Over 3,000 Units
  
  With standardized assembly lines and a large-scale production base, we maintain a monthly output
  of over 3,000 units. This strong production capacity guarantees stable lead times, timely order
  fulfillment, and flexible support for both small-batch orders and large-volume bulk purchases. You
  can count on us for reliable supply, no matter how big your project is.
* 04
  
  ###### Complete After-Sales Support & Full Spare Parts Inventory
  
  We provide a 2-year warranty for all machines, backed by a complete range of readily available
  spare parts. Our dedicated after-sales team offers fast technical support, troubleshooting
  guidance, and maintenance tips. Even for hard-to-reach cleaning dead corners, our spare parts
  inventory ensures you can quickly replace brushes, squeegees, or filters to keep your equipment
  running at peak performance.

  All our cleaning equipment is manufactured under strict ISO 9001 quality management standards and
  fully certified with the CE mark. Every machine undergoes multi-stage quality inspections, from
  raw material selection to factory testing, to ensure compliance with international safety,
  performance, and environmental regulations. You get reliable, safe, and durable cleaning equipment

Bortek stocks and services Ring-O-Matic equipment. ### Industrial Vacuums Industrial wet/dry, explosion-proof, and specialty vacuums for demanding facilities. ## Frequently asked questions

## Are you open on the weekends?

Our office is closed on the weekends, however, customers can schedule appointments in advance to
meet with a salesman on Saturday. Our [regular hours of operations][47] are from 8 am to 5 pm,
Monday through Friday.

## Can you help us with financing?

Yes. Fill out our [credit application][48], which only takes 5 minutes, and you can get approved the
same day.

## Can you help us with shipping/delivery?

Yes. You can contact our sister company, [Transport California][49], for information regarding
deliveries across California. We can also hire a broker to either ship or deliver trucks and
equipment of any size, anywhere.

## Why should I buy from Truck Site?

Truck Site has been in the used truck and equipment business for over 15 years. [Our team][50] is
comprised of highly experienced mechanics, electricians, welders, and body and recon technicians
(over 50 total). When paired with our seasoned sales and support team, your buying experience will
be pleasant. We take great care to ensure your purchase has been prepared and is delivered in
ready-to-work condition.


At Truck Site, we guarantee quality and after-sale support! Head over to our [testimonials page][51]
and see why so many customers across America continue to buy from Truck Site to meet all of their
truck and equipment needs.

## I’m interested in a truck. How do I place a hold on it?

Please contact one of our salesmen who will answer any of your questions regarding the truck of your
interest, after which you can leave a 10% deposit to secure your truck while you finalize the
purchase.

## What services do you perform on your trucks before they sell?

Before any truck is delivered to our customers, it goes through a few stages: First, the truck goes
through our Recon department, where it is washed and prepared for an inspection. Second, after the
thorough inspection, the Service department goes through all the issues identified in the
inspection, from the engine to the tires. In some cases, our Fabrication and Body departments
refurbish worn-out parts. Finally, as part of our quality control, the truck goes through the final
inspection just before the truck is shipped out.

## If I’m out-of-state, can I fly in to personally inspect a truck?

We encourage all customers to inspect our trucks and equipment in-person. If you’re local, you’re
welcome to stop by anytime during our business hours. For long-distance customers, since we are
conveniently located 15 minutes from the Sacramento International Airport (SMF), we will arrange
your pick up and will also drop you off at the airport after your inspection.

## Can I have an independent inspection performed on a truck I’m interested in?

Yes. We welcome any outside technicians or dealers to inspect our vehicles. We are located close to
many of the national dealers, including International, Freightliner, Peterbilt, and Ford. In
addition, Sacramento houses many street sweepers and garbage truck dealers, including Tymco,
Schwarze, Elgin, Heil, Amrep, and McNeilus. After scheduling an appointment with any dealer, please
notify your salesman so we could drop off the unit at the dealer or be ready for on-site inspection.

## Do you take trade-ins?

Yes. Please [email us][52] the information about your trade-in, including engine miles and hours, as
well as the photos of the unit.

## If I can’t find a truck I’m looking for in your inventory, can you locate a specific truck for
## me?

Yes. [Our inventory][53] is updated on a daily basis as new trucks come in and are prepared for
sale. Whether you’re looking for [used street sweepers][54], [garbage trucks][55], [vacuum
trucks][56], [bucket trucks][57], or any other type of work truck, if you can’t find what you’re
looking for, please give us a call or [contact us here][58], and we’ll do our best to find a truck
that fits your needs.

## Can I rent any of your trucks?

Yes, most of the trucks listed on this site could be rented out, just give us a call.

Questions? We can help you answer them. [Contact Us][59]

CaliforniaClean® means the truck has seen little to no road salt, chemicals or snow, and is devoid

## Frequently asked questions

## Are you open on the weekends?

Our office is closed on the weekends, however, customers can schedule appointments in advance to
meet with a salesman on Saturday. Our [regular hours of operations][47] are from 8 am to 5 pm,
Monday through Friday.

## Can you help us with financing?

Yes. Fill out our [credit application][48], which only takes 5 minutes, and you can get approved the
same day.

## Can you help us with shipping/delivery?

Yes. You can contact our sister company, [Transport California][49], for information regarding
deliveries across California. We can also hire a broker to either ship or deliver trucks and
equipment of any size, anywhere.

## Why should I buy from Truck Site?

Truck Site has been in the used truck and equipment business for over 15 years. [Our team][50] is
comprised of highly experienced mechanics, electricians, welders, and body and recon technicians
(over 50 total). When paired with our seasoned sales and support team, your buying experience will
be pleasant. We take great care to ensure your purchase has been prepared and is delivered in
ready-to-work condition.


At Truck Site, we guarantee quality and after-sale support! Head over to our [testimonials page][51]
and see why so many customers across America continue to buy from Truck Site to meet all of their
truck and equipment needs.

## I’m interested in a truck. How do I place a hold on it?

Please contact one of our salesmen who will answer any of your questions regarding the truck of your
interest, after which you can leave a 10% deposit to secure your truck while you finalize the
purchase.

## What services do you perform on your trucks before they sell?

Before any truck is delivered to our customers, it goes through a few stages: First, the truck goes
through our Recon department, where it is washed and prepared for an inspection. Second, after the
thorough inspection, the Service department goes through all the issues identified in the
inspection, from the engine to the tires. In some cases, our Fabrication and Body departments
refurbish worn-out parts. Finally, as part of our quality control, the truck goes through the final
inspection just before the truck is shipped out.

## If I’m out-of-state, can I fly in to personally inspect a truck?

We encourage all customers to inspect our trucks and equipment in-person. If you’re local, you’re
welcome to stop by anytime during our business hours. For long-distance customers, since we are
conveniently located 15 minutes from the Sacramento International Airport (SMF), we will arrange
your pick up and will also drop you off at the airport after your inspection.

## Can I have an independent inspection performed on a truck I’m interested in?

Yes. We welcome any outside technicians or dealers to inspect our vehicles. We are located close to
many of the national dealers, including International, Freightliner, Peterbilt, and Ford. In
addition, Sacramento houses many street sweepers and garbage truck dealers, including Tymco,
Schwarze, Elgin, Heil, Amrep, and McNeilus. After scheduling an appointment with any dealer, please
notify your salesman so we could drop off the unit at the dealer or be ready for on-site inspection.

## Do you take trade-ins?

Yes. Please [email us][52] the information about your trade-in, including engine miles and hours, as
well as the photos of the unit.

## If I can’t find a truck I’m looking for in your inventory, can you locate a specific truck for
## me?

Yes. [Our inventory][53] is updated on a daily basis as new trucks come in and are prepared for
sale. Whether you’re looking for [used street sweepers][54], [garbage trucks][55], [vacuum
trucks][56], [bucket trucks][57], or any other type of work truck, if you can’t find what you’re
looking for, please give us a call or [contact us here][58], and we’ll do our best to find a truck
that fits your needs.

## Can I rent any of your trucks?

Yes, most of the trucks listed on this site could be rented out, just give us a call.

Questions? We can help you answer them. [Contact Us][59]

# Street, Industrial, Airport and Parking Lot Sweeper Manufacturer

TYMCO revolutionized street sweeping in the 1960s with the invention of the Regenerative Air System
which is the sweeping technology behind every TYMCO Sweeper. Today, TYMCO offers an entire product
lineup designed for multiple applications and industries, all based on Regenerative Air. From highly
maneuverable parking lot sweepers, to high dump street sweepers, to high speed airport runway
sweepers and everything in between, TYMCO manufactures a sweeper to help address your cleaning
needs. TYMCO also offers environmentally conscious dustless industrial sweepers and Compressed
Natural Gas (CNG) powered street sweepers.

# Street, Industrial, Airport and Parking Lot Sweeper Manufacturer

TYMCO revolutionized street sweeping in the 1960s with the invention of the Regenerative Air System
which is the sweeping technology behind every TYMCO Sweeper. Today, TYMCO offers an entire product
lineup designed for multiple applications and industries, all based on Regenerative Air. From highly
maneuverable parking lot sweepers, to high dump street sweepers, to high speed airport runway
sweepers and everything in between, TYMCO manufactures a sweeper to help address your cleaning
needs. TYMCO also offers environmentally conscious dustless industrial sweepers and Compressed
Natural Gas (CNG) powered street sweepers.

## Why Should You Sweep?

There are many benefits to sweeping whether you are sweeping streets, parking lots, runways or paved
areas within an industrial facility. These benefits not only include general aesthetics, pride of
keeping pavement clean and conforming to regulations that require it.
* **Improved Aesthetics**
* **Improved Stormwater Runoff Quality**
* **Improved Air Quality**
* **Reduction of Hazards to Automobiles, Cyclists, and Pedestrians**
* **Reduction of FOD Hazards to Aircraft**

### Largest Manufacturer

United Rotary Brush is the largest municipal, contractor and airport runway sweeper broom
manufacturer in North America.

### One Stop Shop

United Rotary Brush has every broom you need to keep your sweepers on the road.

### 7 Locations Nationwide

Since our founding, we’ve built 7 locations across The United States and Canada.

## Your Partner
## From the Start

United Rotary Brush was officially founded in 1990, but our complete history in the broom industry
totals over 80 years of experience. During that time, United Rotary Brush has cultivated industry
knowledge, fostered innovation in the manufacturing of our products, and delivered exceptional
customer service.

## 80+ years of Manufacturing Experience

United Rotary Brush is one of the leading rotary broom manufacturers in the world. With over 80
years of manufacturing experience and growing a full line of rotary broom products, we have a
well-established reputation in the industry for quality, excellence, and innovation.

## Keep Your Machines
## Cleaning with our Brooms

United Rotary Brush offers a variety of brooms for all makes and models of sweepers and attachments.

Tube Brooms

The all-time sweeping classic for street sweeping broom applications. Available in poly or poly/wire
combo broom for best results.

[Shop Now][52]
Strip Brooms

UnitedPro™ Strip Brooms are fully recyclable and available exclusively from United Rotary Brush.
Available for all municipal and paving contractor sweepers.

[Shop Now][53]
Gutter Brooms

We offer gutter brooms for all street sweeper manufacturers. The wire used in our brooms offers high
durability and excellent sweeping performance.

[Shop Now][54]
Wafers

Get your sweeping jobs done right the first time, every time, when you install quality-built wafers
from United Rotary Brush.

[Shop Now][55]
Airport Products

Airport wafers, cassettes, and snowplows—everything you need for operations and groundside pavement.

[Shop Now][56]

## WELCOME TO VICTORY SWEEPERS

# Sweeper Manufacturer in USA

The ROOTS MULTICLEAN, Inc. VICTORY SWEEPERS DIVISION was established in 2017. For over 25 years the
parent company, ROOTS MULTICLEAN LTD., India, which manufactures & sells a complete range of roadway
and floor cleaning solutions, has emphasized products that help build a more hygienic and cleaner
world. This effort is further supported by ROOTS GROUP, which has over 40 years of experience
manufacturing engineering products.

Prior to its purchase by ROOTS, for more than 12 years the VICTORY SWEEPERS brand of parking lot and
street sweepers were known in the USA for their durability and superior performance.

[Read More][137]

## Street, Industrial, Airport and Parking Lot Sweeper Manufacturer

Victory Sweepers is a leading US-based manufacturer of reliable and durable sweeping equipments,
designed to meet the needs of cities, industries, airports, and businesses that demand clean and
safe environments. We offer a complete range of equipment, including sweepers for highways, street
sweepers for municipal cleaning, industrial sweepers for factories and warehouses, airport sweepers
that meet strict safety standards, and parking lot sweepers that keep commercial spaces spotless.

## OEM & Aftermarket Parts, All in One Place

Get high-quality sweeper parts with fair pricing and service you can rely on.

[Visit : https://sweeperpartsonline.com][138]

## WELCOME TO VICTORY SWEEPERS

# Sweeper Manufacturer in USA

The ROOTS MULTICLEAN, Inc. VICTORY SWEEPERS DIVISION was established in 2017. For over 25 years the
parent company, ROOTS MULTICLEAN LTD., India, which manufactures & sells a complete range of roadway
and floor cleaning solutions, has emphasized products that help build a more hygienic and cleaner
world. This effort is further supported by ROOTS GROUP, which has over 40 years of experience
manufacturing engineering products.

Prior to its purchase by ROOTS, for more than 12 years the VICTORY SWEEPERS brand of parking lot and
street sweepers were known in the USA for their durability and superior performance.

[Read More][137]

## Street, Industrial, Airport and Parking Lot Sweeper Manufacturer

Victory Sweepers is a leading US-based manufacturer of reliable and durable sweeping equipments,
designed to meet the needs of cities, industries, airports, and businesses that demand clean and
safe environments. We offer a complete range of equipment, including sweepers for highways, street
sweepers for municipal cleaning, industrial sweepers for factories and warehouses, airport sweepers
that meet strict safety standards, and parking lot sweepers that keep commercial spaces spotless.

## OEM & Aftermarket Parts, All in One Place

Get high-quality sweeper parts with fair pricing and service you can rely on.

[Visit : https://sweeperpartsonline.com][138]

# Street Sweeper Truck Manufacturer

At Nescon, our main focus is building the best mechanical street sweeping broom on the market. We
take pride in creating an innovative and reliable product to help you get the job done. With our
background in general contracting and the asphalt milling industry, we understand the unique needs
of our customers. We have used many different types of brooms in the past and know all of the
problems associated with sweeping in general. Our high-efficiency mechanical street sweeper is
designed to have higher productivity, and be easier to maintain and operate.

## Longest Sweep Available

Our XBroom pickup broom was designed for heavy duty, high production sweeping. Our broom has been
optimized for cleanup behind milling or chipping operations and the fast pace & high volume that is
required to keep up. The extra large hopper capacity means more time sweeping and less time dumping.
The high efficiency hydraulic system and the high torque engine enable the broom to sweep at engine
idle, minimizing brake riding & keeping hydraulic temperatures low. The unique lift system can dump
faster and higher, this leaves the center of the truck wide open for maintenance & clean up. The PLC
control system fully automates the sweeping process enabling the operator to concentrate on driving
and traffic.

Answers to common questions from contractors, municipalities, paving companies, and public works

XBroom by Nescon is a U.S.-based street sweeper manufacturer specializing in heavy-duty mechanical
street sweepers for asphalt milling cleanup, road construction sweeping, municipal maintenance, and
industrial sweeping.

[Learn more about XBroom][38]

2) Who manufactures XBroom street sweepers?

XBroom mechanical street sweepers are designed and manufactured by **Nescon LLC** in Arizona. Nescon
builds high-production sweeping equipment for contractors, municipalities, public works departments,
and industrial operations.

[Why Choose XBroom by Nescon][39]

3) What is an XBroom mechanical street sweeper best used for?

XBroom street sweepers are best used for asphalt milling cleanup, road construction, chip seal
operations, parking lots, industrial sites, and municipal street sweeping.

[View the XBroom Street Sweeper][40]

XBroom sweepers are built for high-production asphalt milling cleanup, helping remove millings,
silica dust, and debris before paving.

XBroom sweepers reduce downtime with a 5-yard net hopper, fewer dump cycles, high hydraulic

maintenance requirements, parts availability, support, and uptime.

Both. XBroom sweepers are used by asphalt contractors, paving companies, heavy civil crews,
municipalities, public works departments, and industrial operators.

improves asphalt adhesion, reduces pavement failure, and supports stormwater control.

strong support.

fleet standards, municipal needs, and operating goals.

## About Zhenda

### Our Story

Founded in 2002, Anhui Zhenda Brush Industry Co., Ltd. is located in Yuantan, the brush industry
base in China. It is a national high-tech enterprise, which integrates the business of research and
development, production and marketing.

The products are exported all over the world, mainly include industrial cylinder brush, road sweeper
brush, wafer brush, floor scrubber brush, strip brush, cow brush, wire brush, drill brush, car wash
brush and more. Till now, our products have been introduced to the embassy’s economic and commercial
counselor’s offices of 14 countries. Anhui Zhenda Brush Industry Co., Ltd. has a scientific R&D team
with a profound theoretical foundation, high technical literacy, and strong research development
capabilities. The company’s focus is on the research of physical and chemical properties of
materials and innovating and optimization of the preparation process of materials. [More info about
our company ›][77]
